candidate_relations.reason: The biopsy shows ovoid-to-spindle neoplastic cells with nuclear atypia and mitosis from a well-demarcated anterior mediastinal mass; the reference diagnosis is Type A thymoma (spindle/oval cell morphology, typically well-encapsulated) rather than thymic carcinoma (which is a distinct, higher-grade entity). Additionally, the reference requires the composite MINOCA diagnosis (progressive troponin elevation, diffusely slow coronary flow with patent vessels, ST changes) which C001 omits entirely. Both the subtype classification and the composite scope are incompatible.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies thymic epithelial malignancy but asserts carcinoma rather than thymoma Type A, and omits the MINOCA component entirely

case_quality_flags: Biopsy description of 'nuclear atypia and mitosis' could support thymic carcinoma over Type A thymoma; Type A thymoma typically shows bland spindle/oval cells with low mitotic activity — reference diagnosis may warrant pathologic clarification
Composite diagnosis (thymoma + MINOCA) is unusual and requires both components to be credited; C001 addresses neither correctly
